about.title: About Dai Cat Holdings
about.intro: With strong financial capacity, solid experience, and a professionally trained team that is enthusiastic, dynamic, creative, and effective, Dai Cat Holdings strives continuously in every circumstance to affirm and elevate its position in Vietnam's real estate market, while maintaining the trust of clients and partners.
about.vision_text: To become one of the 10 largest private economic groups in Vietnam.
about.mission_text: To provide excellent products and services, elevating the value of life.
about.core_value_1_text: Constantly striving forward, aiming higher every single day.
about.core_value_2_text: Honest and transparent in every transaction and commitment to clients.
about.core_value_3_text: A well-trained team that works with dedication and accountability.
about.core_value_4_text: Putting people at the center of every activity and business decision.
